# About the author

Venkatesh Rao is a writer and consultant based in Seattle. He writes the Contraptions newsletter, and is a co-founder and the Director of Research of the Protocol Institute, which grew out of the Summer of Protocols program he directed from 2023 to 2026. He is a core developer of the Blygger protocol. From 2007 to 2024 he wrote the blog Ribbonfarm. His books include *Tempo* (2011) and *vgr: The Twitter Years (2007–22)*.

[venkateshrao.com](https://venkateshrao.com) · [Contraptions](https://contraptions.venkateshrao.com) · [Protocol Institute](https://protocol-institute.org)
